data.content_ref: inline:The 'contradiction' is asserted across different explanatory levels without establishing that SRC_002 ever claimed causal sufficiency. A reduction/inheritance can be mathematically complete while a downstream artifact posits an additional causal layer; that is supplementation, not contradiction. The 'refuted if' clause similarly hedges between accepting algebraic constraint satisfaction as complete and inferring an implicit pricing mechanism, indicating the target never fixes whether the endpoints genuinely conflict or merely address different questions.
